title: Staleness Tracking
description: Derive per-manifest staleness from version drift. Template-version drift stales all manifests for that golden; skill-version drift stales only the affected skill's manifest. Stale state surfaces in UI/CLI and can be cleared without re-running.

requirements.title: Stale derivation
requirements.description: Pure function: given manifest pinned versions + current template/skill versions + an operator-clear-stale flag, return stale ∈ {fresh, stale-template, stale-skill, cleared}. Used by API to compute UI badges and by CLI to require --force / --yes.

validation.notes: Skill-version drift stales only the affected skill's manifest.
Template-version drift stales manifests for that golden.
Live skill_drift flagged (2020-01-01 pin vs current) then cleared by re-pin 2026-05-29.

requirements.title: Clear-stale operation
requirements.description: Operator can set 'cleared' state on a stale manifest, asserting they have reviewed the drift and accept current pinning. Cleared state resets to active stale on the next pinned-version mismatch.

validation.notes: Clear-stale records the operator override timestamp.
Cleared override suppresses the stale flag until the next version mismatch.
